adds.title: Kyrgyzstan: Events of 2024 — Human Rights Watch World Report 2025
adds.summary: thin: no usable finding — the HRW World Report 2025 Kyrgyzstan chapter contains no content on transgender prisoners or prison housing; its only prison references concern journalists and opposition activists sentenced to prison terms (media repressions, freedom of expression), not placement or conditions of trans detainees.

records.note: No prison-housing data found for Kyrgyzstan within budget. enwiki REST full-text search 'transgender prison Kyrgyzstan' returned no trans-prisoner article (top hits: Human rights in Kyrgyzstan, Legal status of transgender people; neither records trans-prisoner placement). Fetched HRW World Report 2025 Kyrgyzstan chapter contains no trans/LGBTI-prisoner content; cached ILGA-Europe Annual Review 2025 Kyrgyzstan contains no prison-related content. No data found on birth-sex vs identity placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners; PRI Kyrgyzstan country pages 404'd.

adds.title: Tajikistan: Events of 2024 — Human Rights Watch World Report 2025
adds.summary: thin: no usable finding — the HRW World Report 2025 Tajikistan chapter contains no content on transgender prisoners or prison housing; its prison/detention references concern opposition figures (Group 24, Islamic Revival Party detainees) and deportees, not placement or conditions of trans detainees.

records.note: No prison-housing data found for Tajikistan within budget. enwiki REST full-text search 'transgender prison Tajikistan' returned no trans-prisoner article (top hits: Legal status of transgender people, LGBTQ rights by country or territory — no Tajikistan trans-prisoner content). Fetched HRW World Report 2025 Tajikistan chapter contains no trans/LGBTI-prisoner content; cached IPHR 'Rights for All?' (Feb 2024) and ILGA-Europe Annual Review 2025 Tajikistan PDFs contain no prison/detention keywords at all. No data found on birth-sex vs identity placement, special units, or solitary/segregation practice for trans prisoners; PRI Tajikistan country pages 404'd. adds kept thin per lane rule; never fabricated.
